You are a literature/adaptation AUTHOR, not a final verifier. User asked to absorb /mnt/c/Users/HuangZY/Downloads/absorption_plan.md and selected_references.bib into the SL project with workflow2.0.1. Read both attachments and /mnt/f/LaTeX/BVE research/AGENTS.md. Your ONLY write root /mnt/f/tools/sl-literature-absorption-20260923/author-approximation; create/maintain its AGENTS.md. Read current project sources; do not edit project/plugin/canonical/old evidence or others' work. No commits or remote writes.
Own L07,L08,L09 and the bounded P2/P4 absorption. Verify against PRIMARY publisher/author/arXiv sources; preserve actual obtained raw PDF/HTML, extracted text, URL/date/status/SHA and exact read page/theorem/equation locators. Inspect original formulas if uncertain. Keep full downloaded texts private here; public deliverables are original concise notes, facts/conditions, own derivations and citations.
Read current docs/SL_cofinite_left_definite.tex, fractional-space and original sparse-family sources/tools as needed. Existing0<=s<7/2 density and s=2 cofinite classification are not open. Verify Full Muntz hypotheses including exponent ranges/distinctness/integrability, theorem's actual weight/norm and limits; obtain legal author full text if possible. Verify Shen's actual boundary-adapted constructions and matrix sparsity versus stability assumptions; don't transfer local Dirichlet results blindly to coupled Krein boundaries. Verify Adcock-Huybrechs sqrt(epsilon) inequality with exact threshold definition.
Produce a mathematically explicit finite-dimensional TSVD error theorem/proof for a general finite synthesis map and distinguish singular-value from Gram-eigenvalue cutoffs. Adapt it conditionally to Kc at fixed c and s=2 or4; investigate a concrete boundary-compatible finite-band Legendre recombination if feasible, proving span/conditions and stating any missing uniform stability bound. For P4, set up two precise retained-index examples (arithmetic vs sparse), derive real project polynomial moment mapping and explain why Full Muntz cannot directly solve the difference family. Prove a useful bounded subclass result if supported, otherwise record exact open bridge and actionable task; no numerical-to-infinite promotion.
Deliver original notes/proofs, 2-4 proposed tool-card JSONs (title/summary/conditions/scope/evidence_status/content/sources), source-manifest.json and REPORT.md. Meaningful exact/numerical checks may be written privately; actual execution records required, never fabricate success or Lean identities. No subdelegation; coordinator will use fresh isolated review. Return paths/hashes, actual read coverage and precise result status.
